description: Battle theory, phase 2 in the game: the test battle's armies (config/armies/test_halves.json) moved to the band of The Moorlands Route with no rocks between them (z -400..-150, data/maps/moorlands-route). Our AI places the army, aligns and approaches in 50 m steps to the window (apps.reach) and holds; the enemy is the game's AI defending (timeout winner). Build with --enemy-ai native --fire: our archers fire at will, losses and arrows are recorded while holding. In the simulation the enemy stands as the game's AI did in the test battle (tools/sim/enemy.py).
